eyebrow: The Deployment and the NetworkPolicy, side by side
code:
# kubectl get deployment grain-ingest -o yaml
spec.selector.matchLabels:
  app: grain-ingest        # Lesson 9's Helm chart

# kubectl get networkpolicy -o yaml
spec.podSelector.matchLabels:
  app: ingest               # Lesson 10's out-of-band kubectl apply
caption: One word off. Zero pods have ever matched this policy.

eyebrow: Proving the mismatch, not eyeballing it
code:
kubectl get pods -n grain -l app=ingest
# No resources found in grain namespace.

kubectl get pods -n grain -l app=grain-ingest --no-headers | wc -l
# 14
caption: 14 pods match the Deployment. 0 match the policy meant to protect them.
